synthetic_checkpoint.scope: Checkpoint restoration only; excludes DB/network/delta replay, uses separate fresh process per repetition, Python allocations measured with tracemalloc

evidence_views.scope: Same current records, fact arrays only; excludes protocol envelope and expansion guidance. No omission of source identity or uncertainty labels.

model_smoke.alternative_extraction_probe: Inconsistent coverage: baseline Spanish emitted one combined request; candidate Spanish and both English runs emitted zero facts. This does not establish improved extraction or false-conflict prevention.

limitations: General historical recall/search still reconstruct full namespace state.
Selective replay can scan the checkpoint twice for evidence and deltas twice; memory reduction is not a universal latency guarantee.
A cross-process lock limits simultaneous historical handlers, not allocator retention or total idle session memory.
Model review labels are probabilistic recommendations; no facts are promoted or user-confirmed.
Short extraction guidance has no demonstrated quality gain in this smoke test.
production_mutations: User-requested merges of person:user and person:session-user into person:rob, preserving aliases and journal history.
Two source-verified DigitalOcean alternative facts had only their erroneous exclusive slots cleared; original claims and citations preserved.
